column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each individual security holding record within funds.
Foreign key referencing funds.TickerSym, indicating which fund holds this security.
Percentage (0-1) of the fund's total assets represented by this individual security holding.
Ranking of this holding within the fund's portfolio (1 = largest holding, 2 = second largest, etc.). Contains  NULL when position ranking is not available or not tracked.
